evals.prompt: 根据 UQ 官方 ECON1050 Course Profile 制作 5 张海乐思小红书课程解析图，封面显示 UQ昆士兰大学，主色统一为蓝色，页眉左侧放完整海乐思 Logo，右侧保留 UQ 原色校徽。
evals.expected_output: 五张 1242×1660 PNG、来源截图、内容方案、carousel.json 与验证结果；事实来自官网并区分 HLS 解读。
expectations: Exactly five numbered PNG files are produced at 1242×1660.
The cover contains UQ昆士兰大学 and all five headers contain both brand lockups.
The layout primary color is #283E7C while the school crest remains an image asset.
No placeholder text or forbidden score-guarantee claims remain.
A machine-readable layout report shows zero overflowing pages.

evals.prompt: 我给你一所大学某门课的官网链接，照 ECON1050 那套做完整课程解析轮播；这门课没有期末考试，最大的考核是 research report。
evals.expected_output: 仍为五页，但第 4 页改为 research report 的任务拆解与决策路径，不虚构 Final。
expectations: Page four adapts to the real core assessment rather than inventing a final exam.
Official facts, editorial interpretation and study advice are visibly separated.
The fixed HLS visual and delivery contracts remain intact.

evals.prompt: 为一门新课程建立课程解析项目骨架，但不要覆盖任何已有目录。
evals.expected_output: 创建规则、源素材、制作工程、审核和版本化最终交付目录，并复制品牌资产、HTML 模板、渲染与验证脚本。
expectations: The scaffold refuses to overwrite an existing target.
The project rules are created before business editing begins.
All required directories, HLS assets and deterministic scripts are present.
